# dsh-plugin-model-dispatch
English | 简体中文
**Give the main model, your subagents, and plan mode their own model and reasoning effort — from the
chat bar, in one menu.**
DeepSeek Harness ships a model picker for the **main** model. This plugin keeps that control and add
s the two routes it does not cover — the model that **delegated subagents** run on, and the model **
plan mode** thinks with — then puts all three in one menu that behaves like a native control.
| Route | Set it from | Applies to |
| **Main model** | chat-bar main chip · settings row 1 | the current session, through the native DSH

switching API |
| **Subagent model** | chat-bar subagent chip · settings row 2 | subagents started

*later* in this session |
| **Planning model** | settings row 3 | plan mode only; the pre-plan main
model is restored afterwards |
## Features
- **Two composer chips, wearing the host's own material.** The input bar carries a main chip (the ho
st's model glyph) and a subagent chip (a branch glyph); the icon alone tells them apart, while the t
ooltip and accessible name keep the full `Main · model · effort` label. Both are borderless 28px chi
ps that only show a surface on hover, exactly like the neighbouring native controls. While the subag
ent route inherits, its chip reads **Follows main** instead of repeating the main model name.
- **One menu for every route.** Search across models and providers, provider groups, favorites, rece
nts, and reasoning effort — the same menu is used by the chat bar and the settings rows. It is built
from the host menu's material (translucent blurred card, elevation shadow, 4px padding, 34px rows,
13px type, l2 hairlines), so it reads as a first-party control rather than a plugin overlay.
- **Reasoning effort as a discrete slider.** One stop per level, plus a leading **provider default**
stop so "don't specify an effort" is a visible state instead of hidden behaviour. The scale is draw
n under the rail (so it never seams the filled run), the current level is named in the header row, a
nd the control is draggable and keyboard-operable.
- **Live apply — no confirm row.** A model pick, a slider move, or a restore writes through immediat
ely. A slider drag coalesces into a single write when it settles, writes are serialized, and a faile
d write rolls the row back and shows the real error. The menu stays open, so picking a model can be
followed straight by an effort change; `Esc` or a click outside only closes the menu and never undoe
t by an effort change; `Esc` or a click outside only closes the menu and never undoes a live choice.
- **Plan-mode auto switching.** Entering plan mode switches to the planning model; approving the pla
n or `/plan off` restores the pre-plan main model *and* effort before the first execution request. T
he review panel shows which model will be restored.
- **Per-session subagent overrides.** A chat-bar subagent pick is stored as a durable override for t
hat session and never touches the settings default; one click restores the settings default.

## Install
Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2** (other 0.2.x versions need a compatibility check — see Comp
DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2** (other 0.2.x versions need a compatibility check — see Compatibility).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with the profile you actually use (`desktop`, …). Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**:
the host half needs a recomposition, and refreshing the page only reloads the client half.
`lib/` is not tracked in git: git installs build the host and client bundles through the package's `
prepare` script, and npm publishes build through `prepack`. For a local checkout, run `pnpm install
&& pnpm build` once before linking.

In the checkout, run `pnpm install && pnpm build` first, then create the matching `node_modules` lin
k (the profile directory is the resolution anchor), then restart DSH.
## Usage
### Chat bar
Two chips sit at the right of the composer, next to the permission and preset controls:
| Chip | What it does |
| **Main** (model glyph) | Switches the current session's model through the native API. The chip sho

ws the effective route and its effort in the tooltip. |
| **Subagent** (branch glyph) | Picks the mo
del for subagents started later in this session, stored as a session override. Reads **Follows main*
* while nothing is overridden. |
Opening either chip gives the same menu: search, provider groups, favorites (★, hover-revealed, reme
mbered per browser), recents, the effort slider, and — for the subagent route — a **restore to setti
), recents, the effort slider, and — for the subagent route — a **restore to settings default** row.
### Settings
**Web settings → Model & Agents** holds four rows, each with a one-line scope hint:
| Row | Meaning |

## Compatibility
- **Host:** DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. The plugin follows the 0.2.x extension surfaces (volatile `Config` + `
configForms`, session projections, the session model-selection API, `planMode`) and patches nothing

in the DSH core, so one-click upstream upgrades stay painless.
- **Newer hosts need ≥1.1.0.** Since
1.1.0 subagent routing wraps all three native start paths — `start` / `startContinuable` (rc.2) and
`startActivation` (newer hosts). On a host that only exposes `startActivation`, 1.0.x is silently by

passed into plain parent-model inheritance.
- **Client:** the browser half ships as a DSH client bun
dle (`lib/client.js`) and needs the host half loaded; a page refresh alone is not enough after a fir
lient.js`) and needs the host half loaded; a page refresh alone is not enough after a first install.
## Known limitations
- Tightly coupled to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 internals (`configForms`, session projections, session controlle

r, plan mode) — re-run the suite after a DSH upgrade.
- Plan-boundary detection depends on the nativ
e `exit_plan_mode` result wording; a DSH wording change delays the restore (the `plan/mode` event is

the fallback).
- Subagent sessions intentionally do not participate in plan switching or subagent o

verrides.
- Menu favorites and recents are per-browser (`localStorage`); they are not part of the se
ssion or the profile.
